targets.title: Detecting the snake in the grass: Attention to fear-relevant stimuli by adults and young children.
targets.evidence_quote: The current crowdsourced replication project was an attempt to replicate a finding from LoBue and DeLoache (2008), Experiment 3, as well as to test for moderation of this effect by protocol (RP:P vs. revised).
targets.outcome_quote: Overall, our findings do not support the hypothesis of enhanced visual detection of evolutionarily relevant threat stimuli in young children.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The conclusion gives an overall negative verdict on the focal finding. The prior RP:P attempt supplies a protocol and comparator; the explicitly named finding being retested is LoBue and DeLoache Experiment 3.
